text:
oncall-bot: :warning: ALERT: GPU pool eu-west-1-A experiencing rapid pod evictions, free GPUs ~12%. Autoscaler struggling.

maya: seeing this on dashboards now — latency creeping and a lot of preemptions. Confirming customer impact.

ash: provider reported node maintenance + a couple of unexpected preemptions. Provisioning queue backed ~25min. ETA for replacements ~27m.

leo: traffic is concentrated on eu-west1 due to routing affinity. Many customers pinned by region; can't just move everything.

nina: Support reports increased 5xxs from corpA, fintechX, and eduLabs. Tickets opening.

maya: immediate mitigation proposal: 1) apply temporary per-tenant soft caps (lower QPS) for the noisy tenants, 2) enable cross-region fallback for non-residency workloads, 3) tighten KV/prefix cache eviction to free memory slots. Anyone object?

ash: agree with soft caps. I'll prepare config push. Also will spin down non-critical background jobs in eu-west1 to free GPUs.

leo: emphasize soft caps returning 503 + Retry-After rather than hard 429s with billing penalties. We should auto-unblock when capacity returns.

maya: executing now. Running checks and pushing rule set.

maya: ```
# quick checks
kubectl -n inference get pods -l pool=eu-west1 -o wide
# emergency rate limit push (internal API)
curl -X POST https://internal-config.local/ratelimit -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL" -d '{"scope":"tenant","buckets":[{"tenant":"corpA","qps":2},{"tenant":"fintechX","qps":1},{"tenant":"eduLabs","qps":1}]}'
```

oncall-bot: Deployment job started: emergency-ratecap-1925001111 by maya.

ash: pushing policy now... gateway accepted the rules. Watch logs. Cache eviction toggled to aggressive.

maya: sample logs after push: 
[INFO] 1925001175 policy applied for corpA qps=2
[WARN] tenant corpA saw 503 for 12 requests in 60s

nina: notified affected customers via status page + DM drafts. corpA asked about ETA and requested SLA credit.

jana: provisional OK for credits, need incident ticket and final numbers to approve formal credit.

leo: also enabling cross-region burst to eu-north1 for non-PII/model-residency workloads. This should offload ~18% of traffic.

ash: note: model cache miss rate rose ~15% after fallback routing — increased downstream latency for some requests. Monitoring SLOs.

maya: decision: enforce soft per-tenant caps for top 6 noisy tenants (corpA, fintechX, eduLabs, dataCo, shoply, analyticsHQ), enable cross-region fallback for non-residency, and pause non-essential long-running batches.

nina: drafting customer comms now. Will send list of affected tenants to ops and SRE for audit.

ash: provider ticket opened PV-7832, referencing maintenance window and unexpected preemptions. ETA replacement nodes +26m.

leo: follow-up action items: 1) tune autoscaler to provision GPUs faster, 2) re-evaluate affinity policies that concentrate traffic, 3) add throttling playbook to runbook.

maya: agreed. I'll update the incident timeline and remove caps once free GPU >30% and sustained for 10m.

oncall-bot: Mitigation applied. Monitoring: free GPUs increased 12% -> 25% within 18m after offload and caps. Next automated check in 20m. Please update thread with any regressions. :white_check_mark:
